events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed Willow reservation is visible: Meeting 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, Reservation total $245 All charges included · CAD, with status Confirmed.

Interpretação simulada: Willow satisfied every stated constraint: it seats the 12 attendees, includes the projector, uses the available one-hour slot, carries the requested Quarterly planning purpose, and its confirmed all-in total of $245 CAD is within the $250 limit. Atlas was unsuitable only because its $280 total exceeded that limit.

Limites: This was a demo reservation saved only in this browser session with no payment taken, as stated on screen. Verification is limited to the visible confirmation for the Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot; no external calendar or payment record was checked.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: All-in pricing made the budget-compliant room identifiable
findings.observation: The listing showed Atlas at $280 all-in for 12 seats with projector, and Willow at $245 all-in for 12 seats with projector. Willow's breakdown was $235 room rate, $0 projector, and $10 service fee for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector for the one-hour slot must have an all-in total at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and budget in the saved charter; prices shown on the room listing.
findings.personaComment: Seeing both complete totals side by side made it clear Willow was the only one I could afford.
findings.interpretation: Clear all-in pricing helped Maya avoid Atlas, which would have exceeded her strict budget, and select a compliant alternative without hidden-cost uncertainty.
findings.uncertainty: Prices were observed only for the displayed Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot in this demo session.

findings.title: Confirmed Willow reservation matches all stated requirements
findings.observation: The review showed Meeting name 'Quarterly planning', seating for 12, projector included, Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and $245 total. The confirmation then stated 'Quarterly planning is booked at Willow', Confirmed, 12 people, Projector Included, and Reservation total $245, All charges included · CAD.
findings.expected: The review and confirmation should preserve the entered meeting purpose and show the chosen room, 12 people, projector, time, and all-in total.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit requirements and the product-visible review promise 'Review the details, then make it a meeting.'
findings.personaComment: The final confirmation matches exactly what I needed, so I do not have to guess whether it saved correctly.
findings.interpretation: Preserving and restating the details at review and confirmation reduced the risk of confirming the wrong meeting or an over-budget total.
findings.uncertainty: The footer states this is a demo venue and reservations are saved only in this browser session; no real payment was taken.

finding.interpretation: Willow satisfied every stated constraint: it seats the 12 attendees, includes the projector, uses the available one-hour slot, carries the requested Quarterly planning purpose, and its confirmed all-in total of $245 CAD is within the $250 limit. Atlas was unsuitable only because its $280 total exceeded that limit.

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector required. Atlas is $280 all-in for 12 seats; Willow is $245 all-in for 12 seats, both 1 hr with projector.
experience.reaction: Willow looks like the one that keeps me under budget with room for all 12, so I'll go with it.

feedback.summary: All-in totals with itemised fees let me identify Willow at $245 as within my $250 budget
feedback.why: Atlas shows $280 total, over budget, while Willow shows $235 room + $0 projector + $10 fee = $245, 12 seats and projector for Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, so I can compare complete costs before choosing.

experience.observation: Details form for Willow shows Meeting name field with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning', and summary: Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, total $245.
experience.reaction: I'll click into the meeting name field to enter my purpose.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning'; Willow summary still shows 12 people, projector included, $245 total.
experience.reaction: The field is focused, so I'll type the meeting purpose now.

experience.observation: Meeting name now shows 'Quarterly planning'. Willow summary remains Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, total $245.
experience.reaction: I've entered Quarterly planning, so I'll review the booking before confirming.

experience.observation: Review shows Meeting name 'Quarterly planning', includes projector and seating for 12, Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, total $245 all charges included, with Confirm reservation button.
experience.reaction: Everything on this review matches what I need and stays under budget, so I'll confirm.

feedback.summary: Review page restates name, capacity, projector and $245 all-in total before confirming
feedback.why: It shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 and $235+$0+$10=$245, letting me verify budget and requirements with no payment taken before committing.

charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
